item.title: Li+-locked domain effect for breaking the temperature stability bottleneck in thermal-detection high-entropy energy storage ceramics
item.description:
اثر دامنه قفل‌شده Li+ گلوگاه پایداری دمایی سرامیک‌های ذخیره‌ساز انرژی آنتروپی‌بالا برای آشکارسازی حرارتی را می‌شکند.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a Li+-locked domain effect within a high-entropy ceramic, preserving polar nanodomains to 300 °C and breaking the temperature-stability bottleneck. It achieves 11.43 J·cm−3, 84.67% efficiency, and Δη/η < 0.3% up to 320 °C, plus Yb3+/Tm3+ optical thermometry (±0.23 K). This enables self-diagnosing, ultra-stable ceramic pulse generators for safer brain pacemakers.
🏷 high-entropy ceramics · energy storage ceramics · thermal detection · temperature stability · Li+ locked domain

item.title: Transference Number of Electrolytes at Infinite Dilution
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a new approach, based on Newman's concentrated solution theory and dilute-limit constraints, to determine the cation transference number at infinite dilution (t+0), validated with PEO/NaTFSI data. Its significance is deriving a simple quadratic equation linking t+0 to readily measurable transport properties, enabling more accurate modeling of concentration gradients and limiting current for improved electrochemical device design and optimization.

item.title: Ultralow Deposition Potential and Antisite-Boosted Diffusivity of Li3Ga2 Anode for All-Solid-State Batteries
item.description:
آند آلیاژی Li3Ga2 با پتانسیل رسوب فوق‌پایین و نفوذ سریع Li، از طریق اختلاط آنتی‌سایت، چگالی جریان بحرانی و عمر چرخه بالایی در باتری تمام‌جامد LiCoO2 فراهم می‌کند.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a Li3Ga2 alloy anode combining an ultralow deposition potential (0.007 V) with fast Li diffusivity (2.0×10–8 cm2 s–1) via moderate Li/Ga antisite mixing. This enables a 24 mA cm–2 critical current density, 96.5% initial Coulombic efficiency, 2000-cycle life, and stable pouch cells—redefining alloy anode design by synergistically optimizing potential and atomic diffusivity.
🏷 Li3Ga2 alloy anode · all-solid-state battery · Li diffusivity · antisite mixing · deposition potential
